Our task is to find A, B and C such that

16x2+55x+19(2x+1)(x+5)(x+1)=A(2x+1)+B(x+5)+C(x+1).

Multiplying both sides by (2x+1)(x+5)(x+1) gives

16x2+55x+19=A(x+5)(x+1)+B(2x+1)(x+1)+C(2x+1)(x+5).

For x=−12, we get 16(−12)2+55(−12)+19=A(−12+5)(−12+1)=+B(2(−12)+1)(−12+1)=+C(2(−12)+1)(−12+5)4−552+19=A(94)46−552=A(94)A=−3618A=−2.

For x=−5, we get 16(−5)2+55(−5)+19=A(−5+5)(−5+1)=+B(2(−5)+1)(−5+1)=+C(2(−5)+1)(−5+5)400−275+19=B((−9)(−4))B=14436B=4.

For x=−1, we get 16(−1)2+55(−1)+19=A(−1+5)(−1+1)=+B(2(−1)+1)(−1+1)=+C(2(−1)+1)(−1+5)16−55+19=C(−4)C=−20−4C=5. Hence, 16x2+55x+19(2x+1)(x+5)(x+1)=−2(2x+1)+4(x+5)+5(x+1).

Your Answer:
−4(2x+1)+7(x+5)+4(x+1)
